class.name: GaeaLayer
class.brief_description: A layer of the [GaeaResult] of a [GaeaGraph]. Doesn't hold the result data but holds information about which type of data is allowed.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], this layer's value will be [code]null[/code].

The [enum GaeaValue.ArgType] of this layer. [GaeaRenderer]s care only about [constant GaeaValue.ARG_TYPE_MAP] layers, but [GaeaResult] can hold any type of values. Only wireable types (see [method GaeaValue.is_wireable]).
